# AskNCERT

> AI-powered study assistant built for Indian NCERT students from Class 5 to Class 12. Ask questions, scan chapters, solve problems, save notes and plan your study.

AskNCERT helps NCERT students get instant AI explanations, chapter summaries, formulas, MCQ practice and homework help in English and Hindi.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page for AskNCERT.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an AskNCERT account.
